content.text:
No, you don't need them. The layout now handles this, and the hard-coded values leave an empty strip on the right of the page. **Why it was added:** it came from #13074 (Oct 2025). Back then the page container in [AppRouter.tsx](/Users/vinutv/code/care_fe/src/Routers/AppRouter.tsx) was a flex child without `min-w-0`, so a wide payments table could push the page wider than the screen. Capping the width at "100vw minus the sidebar" was a workaround for that. **Why it's no longer needed:** `a7f36598f` (Sep 2026, "Unify workspace navigation and shared headers") fixed the root cause: - [SidebarInset](/Users/vinutv/code/care_fe/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx:333) now has `min-w-0 max-w-full overflow-hidden`, so the page area can't grow past the space beside the sidebar. - Wide content already scrolls inside the page. `PaymentsData` wraps the table in `overflow-x-auto`, and the shared [ui/table.tsx](/Users/vinutv/code/care_fe/src/components/ui/table.tsx) adds its own `overflow-x-auto` container. **Why the values are now wrong:** with today's layout (16rem sidebar, `m-2` inset margin, `md:px-6` padding), the real available width is about: | Sidebar | Available width | What the code sets | Wasted on the right | |---|---|---|---| | Open | `100vw − 19.5rem` | `100vw − 21.5rem` | about 2rem | | Collapsed | `100vw − 4rem` | `100vw − 8rem` | about 4rem | The cap also makes the Create Payment button sit short of the right edge, unlike other pages. **Suggested change** in [PaymentReconciliationList.tsx](/Users/vinutv/code/care_fe/src/pages/Facility/billing/paymentReconciliation/PaymentReconciliationList.tsx): drop the conditional classes, then remove `useSidebar`, `cn` and `isSidebarOpen`, which become unused. ```tsx
{/* header + unchanged */}
``` The same hack is in two other places and can be removed the same way: - [DeliveryOrderShow.tsx](/Users/vinutv/code/care_fe/src/pages/Facility/services/inventory/externalSupply/deliveryOrder/DeliveryOrderShow.tsx:432) (`22.5rem` / `9rem`) - [PatientProfile.tsx](/Users/vinutv/code/care_fe/src/components/Patient/PatientProfile.tsx:112) (`25rem` / `8rem`) This conclusion comes from reading the CSS and git history only. I haven't checked it in a browser because no backend is running on `:9000`. After removing it, look at the payments list with the sidebar open and collapsed on a medium-width screen; the table should scroll sideways inside the page rather than the whole page scrolling.
